item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the response by WA Police to four earlier recommendations and a later force incident involving the same officer.
item.support: The report also includes a case study detailing the circumstances of the officer's more recent excessive use of force incident

item.text: The recommendations concerned training, custody records and management, supervision of inexperienced officers and use of force reporting.
item.support: The Commission made four recommendations for improvements to officer training and changes to policy

item.text: The Commission concluded that WA Police had adequately addressed the first three recommendations.
item.support: The Commission considers that the WA Police Force has taken appropriate steps to address recommendations one, two and three.

item.text: The Commission kept the reporting recommendation open because policy changes were incomplete and planned to follow up after one year.
item.support: In response to recommendation four, the Commission considers it incomplete and intends to follow up on this recommendation in one year's time.

item.quote: The Commission considers that the WA Police Force has taken appropriate steps to address recommendations one, two and three.
In response to recommendation four, the Commission considers it incomplete and intends to follow up on this recommendation in one year's time.
